{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABeiGhUQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIDIKM", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 304, "title": "Remove redundant Node help and ports section from Graph Editor Inspector", "body": "## Goal

Remove the **"Node help and ports"** collapsible section from the **right-hand Settings Inspector** of Graph Editor. It repeats port names/types already visible on graph nodes, and its long, dense Node help text is not useful in this form. The Inspector should focus on settings and actions.

**Do not replace this section with another help panel, shortened help, or tooltip as part of this issue.** We can reconsider contextual help separately if a concrete need emerges.

## Current implementation (main branch)

In [`extension/graph-editor.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph-editor.js), `GraphEditor.drawInspector()` currently appends this after the node's settings:

```js
const details = el('details');
details.append(el('summary', 'Node help and ports'));
if (definition.help) details.append(el('p', definition.help));
for (const side of ['input', 'output']) {
  for (const [name, contract] of portDisplayEntries(definition, side)) {
    details.append(el('p', `${side === 'input' ? 'Input' : 'Output'} ${name}: ${contract.name}`, 'muted'));
  }
}
this.inspector.append(details);
```

This is the **per-node Settings Inspector disclosure**, not the Graph Editor-wide Help (?) dialog.

## Required changes

1. **Remove the entire "Node help and ports" disclosure** from `drawInspector()`: its `<details>`, summary, long `definition.help` paragraph and repeated input/output port listing.
2. Leave all **actual node settings and controls** exactly where they are: node name/type heading, instance ID, Remove Node, configuration fields, optional text/number settings, Display input labels, Add input/Remove last input, subgraph-related controls, connection inspector, and any existing error/validation messages. Do not create a new replacement UI.
3. **Preserve port information on the graph canvas**, including port names, directions, type contracts, ordering, connection behavior, accessible labels, keyboard interactions, and compatibility validation. In particular, **do not delete the `portDisplayEntries` import/function** merely because the Inspector section is removed: the node canvas still calls it to render ports (near `GraphEditor.draw()`).
4. **Do not delete the underlying `NODE_TYPES[...].help` descriptions or node-definition metadata globally** solely because this Inspector no longer renders them; avoid changing core contracts, port definitions, or any other consumers.
5. Remove only obsolete Inspector-specific rendering code and any CSS/test expectations specifically dedicated to this disclosure. Keep other `<details>` elements and dialogs, e.g. subgraph exposed-port editing or graph actions.
6. If a functional constraint is important for editing/execution, do not silently bypass its existing validation, error messages, or licensing/terms paths just because the explanatory paragraph is gone. Keep the separate Models/terms access intact.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Selecting any normal Node, a Display/TextFormatter Node, or a reusable Subgraph instance **does not render "Node help and ports"** or its expanded/collapsed contents in the Settings Inspector.
- [ ] Node settings and actions remain visible and fully usable; no unnecessary whitespace remains at the Inspector bottom.
- [ ] On-canvas ports still show their names, types and directions, with unchanged connection validation, and both mouse and keyboard interactions continue to work.
- [ ] Connection/no-selection Inspector views and reusable subgraph exposed-port controls remain unaffected.
- [ ] The Inspector remains usable at narrow and desktop viewport widths.
- [ ] No unrelated storage, graph-serialization, runtime, model download, or graph-editing behavior changes.

## Tests and documentation

- Update/add focused assertions in [`tests/browser/extension-layout.spec.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/tests/browser/extension-layout.spec.js) and/or relevant extension Inspector tests to ensure the disclosure is absent while settings and node ports still work. Keep unrelated `.graph-inspector details` expectations that refer to other legitimate disclosures, adjusting only if directly impacted.
- Review [`tests/extension/layout.spec.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/tests/extension/layout.spec.js) and existing graph interaction tests for assumptions about Inspector help.
- Update outdated instructions in [`docs/extension-graph.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/docs/extension-graph.md) that explicitly describe Inspector **Node help and ports**, without deleting useful port contract documentation elsewhere.
- Run affected browser/extension tests and report results in the PR.

## Relationship to other tasks

- [#300](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/300) removes the **global Graph Editor Help (?) button/dialog**. Its earlier instruction to **preserve "Node help and ports"** reflected the earlier decision; **this issue supersedes only that preservation requirement**. The now-agreed UX is to remove **both** the global help dialog (#300) and this per-node disclosure (this issue). Do not remove unrelated operational warnings or the model/legal information paths.
- [#301](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/301) independently removes the divider under the Inspector header; changes should compose without recreating borders/dividers.
- [#299](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/299) handles autosave/undo/redo; do not interfere with its Inspector state and change tracking.
